Sub.: Results Earnings Conference Call Q1 FY27 - Audio Recording 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In continuation to our letter dated August 03, 2026, we would like to inform that Audio Recording of 
the Earnings Conference Call held today i.e. on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (IST), for 
the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, has been made 
available on the Company’s website at https://www.kecrpg.com/earning-call-transcripts. 
 
The above is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours sincerely,
